scope: Original table-based heading math used by moving path attachments.

mappings.coverage: complete finite nonnegative first-quadrant table helper; original low16-bit result
mappings.qualification: Finite inputs; first-quadrant helper requires nonnegative components, not both zero, and the exact513-word table. General direction handles zero inputs. NaN/infinity and invalid table storage are excluded. Native upper EAX bits of5be030 are not part of the ushort return contract. The angle table is an original-data dependency with explicit provenance, not a newly derived analytic approximation. No authored command credit. Managed replay compiled only; native results compare an independent Python model with original x86.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original-PC comparisons passed; portable replay compile only.
